correctness.rationale: Uniform binary words with a>=1 ones, b>=2 zeros, n=a+b>=6. Each fixed specified configuration with r ones and s zeros has probability (a)_r(b)_s/(n)_(r+s). For the ordered 001/010 window pairs, exactly (n-4)(n-5) disjoint and two compatible overlap families (n-4) length-five 01001 and (n-3) length-four 0010 contribute; other overlaps are incompatible. The resulting mixed moment and subtracting equal mean squared gives Cov=-ab(b-1)P(a,b)/(n²(n-3)(n-2)(n-1)²). For b<=a+1 set v=a-b+1 and positive polynomial coefficients show P>0; for b>=a+2 set v=b-a-2 and negative coefficients show P<0, including the b=2,a>=4 and a=1,b>=5 edge cases. New independent direct word enumeration confirmed 39 complete composition cases 6<=n<=11 and all covariance signs; universal proof rests on finite overlap partition plus polynomial identities, not extrapolation.
